BGP_SRV6_GRT_VALID.desc: Configure BGP SRv6 GRT locator, SID advertisement policy, and neighbor encapsulation.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_DEFAULT_IPV4_SID_ADVERTISE.desc: IPv4 SID advertisement defaults to disabled.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_DEFAULT_IPV6_SID_ADVERTISE.desc: IPv6 SID advertisement defaults to disabled.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_INVALID_LOCATOR.desc: BGP SRv6 GRT references a locator that does not exist.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_INVALID_IPV4_PREFIX_LIST.desc: BGP SRv6 GRT references an IPv4 prefix list that does not exist.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_INVALID_IPV6_PREFIX_LIST.desc: BGP SRv6 GRT references an IPv6 prefix list that does not exist.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_INVALID_LOCATOR_FORMAT.desc: SRv6 locator uses an unsupported format.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_INVALID_IPV4_SID_ADVERTISE.desc: IPv4 SID advertisement has an invalid boolean value.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_INVALID_ENCAPSULATION_TYPE.desc: BGP neighbor uses an unsupported encapsulation type.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_FRRCFGD_VALID.desc: Configure BGP SRv6 GRT using the generic BGP tables consumed by frrcfgd.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_FRRCFGD_INVALID_LOCATOR.desc: BGP global configuration references a locator that does not exist.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_FRRCFGD_INVALID_ROUTE_MAP.desc: BGP SID advertisement references a route map that does not exist.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_FRRCFGD_INVALID_ADVERTISEME.desc: BGP SID advertisement has an invalid boolean value.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_FRRCFGD_ORPHAN_ROUTE_MAP.desc: A SID advertisement route map requires an advertisement setting.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_FRRCFGD_UNSUPPORTED_AF.desc: SID advertisement is configured for an unsupported VRF/address family.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_FRRCFGD_INVALID_NEIGHBOR_AF.desc: BGP neighbor AF uses an unsupported encapsulation type.

BGP_SRV6_GRT_FRRCFGD_INVALID_PEER_GROUP_.desc: BGP peer-group AF uses an unsupported encapsulation type.
